title: Producer never approves: a different agent verdicts every handoff
subject: producer-not-approver
ratio: A producer never approves its own work. A worker finishing a task can only hand off; the done verdict belongs to a different agent, and the check is mechanical in blackboard.py, not advisory: update --status done is refused unless a handoff record exists and the acting agent differs from the handoff producer. Authorship governs, not current status: only the original producer of record is blocked from verdicting. The single sanctioned exception, the P-022 verifier-execute path for verifier-role tasks, is codified in its own record and does not widen this rule.
dicta: The census worst multi-homing case: seven homes verified live - ORCHESTRATION.md:99 (primary) and :7 (headline), AGENTS.md:34, :60, :111 and :138, .harness/README.md:56, PRECEDENT.md:178 (the tier-3 definition leans on it), plus the NLAH statements in claude.md sections 2A and 4B and gemini.md:33, listed per CD8 and never anchored per CD2. One record, every home cited, primary named (CD8); any second appearance of this norm is subsumed by this record. Tier 2 on P-009, the accepted_mutations entry that made the check mechanical; T-031 is the guardrail task, verdicted by rotated verifier-b (ORCHESTRATION.md:119-127 cites events.jsonl:585). Frozen by the codification ledger row decision:T-377#cd-04.
scope_conditions: role:worker handing off any produced task
revisit_trigger: Revisit if the mechanical done-guard is weakened, or a sanctioned self-approval path other than the P-022 verifier-execute exception appears.
validity_conditions: the done-guard refuses update --status done when acting agent equals handoff producer
